Chief_Complaint.content: 2-month history of worsening anxiety with morning dread of leaving house and going to work, sleep disturbance, and palpitations
Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC: 2-mo hx worsening anxiety; morning dread of leaving house/work; sleep disturbance; palpitations

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Anxiety began approximately 2 months ago associated with starting a new job at a fashion retailer head office, with a difficult boss and high work stress
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Onset/Context: Began ~2 mo ago with new job (fashion retailer HO); boss difficult; high work stress

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Sleep schedule is typically between 22:00 and 23:00 with prolonged sleep onset latency and shallow sleep
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Sleep: Bed 22:00–23:00; prolonged SOL; shallow sleep

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Currently sleeps approximately 3 to 4 hours per night
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Sleep: Bed 22:00–23:00; prolonged SOL; shallow sleep; ~3–4 h/night

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Wakes before the alarm with palpitations and panic about being late
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: wakes before alarm with palpitations/panic about being late

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Palpitations are rapid and feel irregular, lasting minutes up to about 10 minutes
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Palpitations: Rapid, feels irregular; lasts mins (up to ~10 min)

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Palpitations are new in the last 2 months
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Palpitations: Rapid, feels irregular; lasts mins (up to ~10 min); new in last 2 mo

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies typical chest pain but has pain or discomfort when heart rate is very fast
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: denies typical CP but notes pain/discomfort when HR very fast

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports very low energy, anhedonia, feeling on edge, and reduced socialising and hobbies such as running and tennis
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Daytime fxn: Very low energy; anhedonia; “on edge”; reduced socialising/hobbies (running/tennis)

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Despite symptoms, still attends work but often considers calling in sick and has not yet missed work
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: still attending work but often considers calling in sick; has not missed work

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Symptoms are triggered by work and public transport, especially on the tube with heat and airlessness
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Triggers: Work; public transport esp. tube (heat/airless)

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies previous similar episodes of anxiety or palpitations
Mood is low on most days including weekends
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Mood: Low most days incl. weekends

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies suicidal ideation and reports good family support
No significant change in appetite, eating regularly but with increased chocolate intake
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Appetite: No sig change; eating regularly; ↑ chocolate

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has spoken with her mother about symptoms and has no prior therapy but is open to one-to-one therapy
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Psych supports: Talked with mother (hx depression); no prior therapy; open to 1:1 therapy

Medications.content: Medications for anxiety and related symptoms were discussed but are not first line at present and were not started
Medications.source_text: Meds discussed; not 1st line at present

Family_History.content: Mother has a history of depression

Social_and_Family_History.content: Works in fashion retail head office
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: SH: Lives with parents; works in fashion retail HO

Social_and_Family_History.content: Alcohol use consists of binge drinking on Friday and Saturday with amounts over the recommended limit and occasional weekday wine
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: etOH: binge Fri/Sat (states over limit) + occasional weekday wine

Assessment.content: Anxiety related to new job with associated insomnia, low mood, and functional impact; denies suicidal ideation; continues to attend work
Assessment.source_text: 1) Anxiety related to new job with associated insomnia, low mood, functional impact; denies SI; continues to attend work

Assessment.content: Palpitations are likely anxiety-related with brief, subjectively irregular episodes and no chest pain beyond discomfort during tachycardia
Assessment.source_text: 2) Palpitations likely anxiety-related; brief episodes, subjectively irregular; no chest pain beyond discomfort during tachycardia

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient to self-refer to NHS talking therapy, with link to be sent
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Self-refer to NHS talking therapy (link to be sent)

Plan_of_Care.content: Online resources provided for the patient to start immediately for anxiety and related symptoms
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Online resources provided to start immediately

Plan_of_Care.content: Sleep hygiene information added to the notes for patient guidance
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Sleep hygiene info added to notes

Plan_of_Care.content: Safety-net advice given to call if symptoms worsen or if unable to cope with work or activities of daily living
